headline: ANKLE-LENGTH. RAIN-READY.
concept: Low-angle Indian metro-platform monsoon commute scene focused on ankle-length hems and rain-ready footwear, with a navy headline panel and red divider.

distinct_from_recent_creatives.cotton_jeans_banner: Uses a metro platform and cropped lower-body framing instead of two full-body men walking on an outdoor pavement with a dark left overlay.
distinct_from_recent_creatives.light_blue_jeans_banner: Uses one continuous cinematic photograph instead of torn-paper collage panels, a translucent numeral and multiple inset frames.
